notes.title: More details and improved RC car control
notes.content:
Hey guys, 
first of all sorry for not updating the VR experience for such a long time. The game is a side project we only have occasional time to work on. But the last few weeks we focused on it. We added more details to the room to give it a more complete look. And we refactored the behavior of the RC car on the tracks. The RC car now follows the tracks as you know it from stock car race tracks such as Carrera. We know its still not perfect but we will continue working on it to make it as much fun as possible. 

We hope you like the update and please let us know what else you would like to see improved.

Oh and last but not least we have added a little Christmas atmosphere. 

Merry Christmas!

notes.title: Out Of Colors is live in early access
notes.content:
Wohooo, we did it. Our VR game Out Of Colors is live. We will post updates and some easter eggs here and on twitter. There is also a new blog post on our website for you to read: [url=http://granolastudios.com/blog/out-of-colors-is-now-available-on-steam-in-early-access-for-all-of-you] Here it is[/url]. 

If you have any questions about the game let us know.

Thanks for playing our game.

notes.title: Private Beta Update now available
notes.content:
Hey guys, 
we have just uploaded a new version of OutOfColors. Everything should now work fine on Oculus Rift + touch and HTC Vive. But of course we are still working on the game and make progress every day. Some issues we are aware of are listed on our [url=http://granolastudios.com/blog/new-vr-game-out-of-colors-now-available-for-preview-on-steamvr]studio blog[/url].
Thanks for playing our game.

notes.title: Steam keys will be posted on our twitter account
notes.content:
Hi guys, 
we are coming closer to our launch and we invite players to test the game before the official release. So if you are interested just check out our [url=http://twitter.com/granolastudios] twitter account [/url] . We will post one key a day. 

You can also signup to our early access list on our [url=http://granolastudios.com] website [/url].  We will send out steam keys to selected subscribers too. 

Thanks for playing our games.
